description_en: The fixed-line AXN extension number introduces extension numbers on top of the fixed-line AXN privacy number, thereby reducing the usage of X numbers. When making a call, first dial the X number, and then enter the corresponding extension number after hearing the prompt tone to be connected to A. The fixed-line AXN extension number service is currently invitation-only. Contact your technical support to activate the service and obtain integration support
description_zh: 固话AXN分机号在固话AXN隐私号基础上引入了分机号，从而降低X号码的使用量，在呼叫时候首先拨打X号码，听到提示音后输入对应分机号转接到A。固话AXN分机号目前为邀约制，请联系您的技术支持进行服务开通，并提供对接支持
kebab_example: aliyun dyplsapi bind-axn-extension-fixed-line --app-id FC100000168480000 --ts 20161114143116123 --order-id 1230000000 --bind-type mode101 --subts 20161114143116 --tela '手机号：18200002371_固话：057100000036' --anucode 1,2,3 --expiration 60 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BindAxnExtensionFixedLine

parameters.help_en: Business timestamp. Format: yyyyMMddHHmmssSSS. Uses Beijing time, 24-hour clock, accurate to milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 业务时间戳，格式：yyyyMMddHHmmssSSS，时间采用北京时间，24小时制，精确至毫秒
parameters.name: ts

parameters.help_en: Unique identifier of the message request
parameters.name: order_id

parameters.help_en:
Binding type. Valid values:

mode101: Customer specifies the X number.

mode102: Platform assigns the X number
parameters.help_zh:
绑定类型。取值：

mode101：客户指定X号码。

mode102：平台分配X号码
parameters.name: bind_type

parameters.help_en: Binding time. Format: yyyyMMddHHmmss. Uses Beijing time, 24-hour clock
parameters.help_zh: 绑定时间，格式为yyyyMMddHHmmss。时间采用北京时间，24小时制
parameters.name: subts

parameters.help_en:
The A number for the fixed-line AXN extension number.

The A number can be set to a mobile number or a fixed-line number. Fixed-line numbers must include the area code, and no hyphen is needed between the area code and the number
parameters.help_zh:
固话AXN分机号的A号码。

A号码可设置为手机号码或固定电话，固定电话需要加区号，区号和号码中间不需要加连字符
parameters.name: tela

parameters.help_en: The X number for the fixed-line AXN extension number. The X number is a privacy number that you have purchased (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/numberbuy) in the console
parameters.help_zh: 固话AXN分机号的X号码。X号码是您在控制台已购买的隐私号 (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/numberbuy)
parameters.name: telx

parameters.help_en: Extension number. This parameter is required when the BindType parameter is set to mode101
parameters.help_zh: 分机号。BindType参数为mode101时此参数必填
parameters.name: tel_xext

parameters.help_en:
Caller-side ringtone code. This parameter is required for AXB scenarios. Must contain codes for 3 scenarios. Enter the codes in the order of "B->X, A->X, other numbers->X", separated by commas.

"1,2,3" indicates that the ringtone code for B->X is 1, for A->X is 2, and for other numbers->X is 3
parameters.help_zh:
主叫侧放音编码，AXB业务时必须设置。必须包含3个场景的编码。按照“B->X,A->X,其他号码->X”的顺序填写编码，编码之间以逗号分隔。

“1,2,3”表示B->X放音编号为1，A->X放音编号为2，其他号码->X放音编号为3
parameters.name: anucode

parameters.help_en:
Called-side ringtone code after connection. Must contain codes for 2 scenarios. Enter the codes in the order of "A as called party, B as called party", separated by commas.

"1,2" indicates that the ringtone code when A is the called party is 1, and the ringtone code when B is the called party is 2
parameters.help_zh:
接通后被叫侧放音编码，必须包含2个场景的编码。按照“A被叫,B被叫”的顺序填写编码，编码之间以逗号分隔。

“1,2”表示A号码为被叫侧接听时的放音编号为1，B号码为被叫侧接听时的放音编号为2
parameters.name: anucodecalled

parameters.help_en:
Caller-side ringtone code after connection. Must contain codes for 2 scenarios. Enter the codes in the order of "A as called party, B as called party", separated by commas.

"1,2" indicates that the caller-side ringtone code when A is the called party is 1, and the caller-side ringtone code when B is the called party is 2
parameters.help_zh:
接通后主叫侧的放音编码，必须包含2个场景的编码。按照“A被叫,B被叫”的顺序填写编码，编码之间以逗号分隔。

“1,2”表示A号码为被叫时主叫侧的放音编号为1，B号码为被叫时主叫侧的放音编号为2
parameters.name: t_anucode_connect

parameters.help_en:
Expiration time. Unit: seconds. Valid values:

0: Never expires.

Other values: When other values are specified, such as 60, the binding is valid for 60 seconds after the X number is successfully assigned. After 60 seconds, the binding is automatically released
parameters.help_zh:
过期时间，单位：秒，取值：

0：永不过期。

其他数值：传其它数值时，比如60s，分配X号码成功的60秒内，绑定有效；超过60s后，自动解绑
parameters.name: expiration

parameters.help_en: Area code. Supports specifying the home location of the X number (specified city -> provincial capital -> nationwide routing). If no home location is specified, a number is randomly assigned nationwide
parameters.help_zh: 区号。支持指定X号码归属地（指定城市->省会->全国路由）。不指定归属地，全国随机
parameters.name: areacode

parameters.help_en: External business extension field. This parameter is returned in call record receipt messages. Must not exceed 100 characters
parameters.help_zh: 外部业务扩展字段，通话记录回执消息中会回传此参数。不能超过100个字符长度
parameters.name: remark

fields.help_en:
Callback control. When A calls through X, that is, A dials X as the caller. Valid values:

0 (default): Cannot make outbound calls.

1: Connect to the most recent N number.

2: Call back the fixed number TelB
fields.help_zh:
回拨控制。A通过X呼叫，即A主叫X。取值：

0（默认值）：不能外呼。

1：接续最近的N号码。

2：回拨固定号码TelB
fields.name: callback

fields.help_en:
Recording control. Valid values:

0 (default): No recording.

1: Recording.

After you enable the call recording feature, you can play and download audio files in the call records. Recording files are billed at CNY 0.010/minute
fields.help_zh:
录音控制。取值：

0（默认值）：不录音。

1：录音。

开启通话录音功能后，可在呼叫记录中播放和下载语音文件。录音文件按通话分钟计费0.010元/分钟
fields.name: callrecording

0: Success.

For other error codes, see [API Error Codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/59892.html）
Code.description_zh:
接口请求状态码。取值：

0：成功。

其他错误码，请参见[API错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/59892.html）

Code.title_zh: 响应码 0：成功，其它失败，具体见文档

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Indicates whether the API call was successful. Valid values:

true: Successful.

false: Failed
Success.description_zh:
接口调用是否成功。取值：

true：成功。

false：失败
